description:
In the world of Remnant, a place where science and fairy tales coexist, human civilization is plagued by deadly monsters known as the Grimm. For a time, victory by the Grimm seemed all but certain, if not for the heroism of those sworn to protect humanity -- Huntsmen and Huntresses. These warriors are trained and assembled into teams at schools like Beacon Academy, where Ruby meets Weiss and Blake -- forming Team RWBY along with Ruby’s sister, Yang. While team RWBY studies to become the greatest Huntresses the world of Remnant has ever known, they are faced with a horrifying threat..

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Note: The first three episodes received an advance release on Crunchyroll on June 24, 2022. The regular TV broadcast started on July 3, 2022.

Ruby Rose is a student of Beacon Academy and the main protagonist of RWBY.

She first appeared in the "Red" Trailer visiting the grave of her deceased mother, Summer Rose.

After an invitation from Headmaster [Ozpin](https://anilist.co/character/268340/Ozpin) following an altercation with [Roman Torchwick](https://anilist.co/character/133837/Roman-Torchwick), Ruby attends Beacon Academy in order to become a Huntress. During her time at Beacon, she becomes the leader of Team RWBY, consisting of herself, [Weiss Schnee](https://anilist.co/character/126143/Weiss-Schnee), [Blake Belladonna](https://anilist.co/character/132314/Blake-Belladonna), and her half-sister [Yang Xiao Long](https://anilist.co/character/132223/Yang--Xiao-Long). Ruby's weapon of choice is her High-Caliber Sniper-Scythe known as Crescent Rose.

Weiss Schnee is a student of Beacon Academy and one of the four members of team RWBY.

The heiress of the vastly influential Schnee Dust Company, Weiss made her first appearance in the "White" Trailer. After enrolling in Beacon against the wishes of her father, she becomes a member of Team RWBY alongside [Ruby Rose](https://anilist.co/character/126569/Ruby-Rose), [Blake Belladonna](https://anilist.co/character/132314/Blake-Belladonna), and [Yang Xiao Long](https://anilist.co/character/132223/Yang--Xiao-Long). Her weapon of choice is a Multi Action Dust Rapier (MADR) named Myrtenaster.

Yang is the half-sister of [Ruby Rose](https://anilist.co/character/126569/Rose-Ruby), a member of team RWBY, and a huntress in training at Beacon academy. 

She claims to be a thrill seeker and states that is the main reason she is a huntress. One of her current, and biggest goals, is finding her mother who went missing shortly after Yang was born.

node.description:
Blake is a fair skinned young woman with amber eyes and long, black hair. A ribbon is tied with a large bow on the top of her head, which acts as a cover for her Faunus heritage and disguises her black cat ears. She wears purple eyeshadow in catseye style.

She wears a black buttoned vest with coattails and a single silver button on the front. Underneath this is a white, sleeveless, high necked, crop undershirt and white shorts with a zipper on the front of each leg, emblazoned with the YKK logo of the real-life Japanese zipper manufacturer.

She also wears black low-heeled boots and full stockings with a color gradation of black to purple at her ankles. Her emblem is visible on the outside of both thighs just below her shorts in white. On her left arm is a detached sleeve with a silver cuff around her bicep, and black ribbons are wrapped around both forearms. A small, loose scarf is wrapped around her neck and a gray magnetic backpack is strapped to her back, hidden by her hair.

Pyrrha is a student of Beacon Academy, and a member of Team JNPR.

She is a composed and collected individual who, despite being a celebrity, is modest and patient around other people, making her very sociable. Additionally, she tends to be quite formal. In addition to her impressive strength and vast range of combat abilities, she is a quick thinker, knowing her limits and assessing her opponents before acting. Her weapon of choice, called Miló, is a red-and-bronze spear-like weapon that can transform into a rifle or a short sword. She uses this alongside a shield called Akoúo̱, which resembles a classic hoplon. 

Pyrrha takes her studies and relationships equally seriously, making her a bit stubborn and emotionally sensitive. This comes from her loyalty toward her friends as well as her good intent. She is always willing to keep secrets and help friends in need, and is selfless and righteous to a fault. Her limited experience with people leads her to apologize even when she's helping them. 

She quickly became good friends with her teammates, especially [Jaune](https://anilist.co/character/134355/Jaune-Arc), and also gets along with Team RWBY, often having conversations during lunches and sharing a similar schedule during classes. However, she sometimes feels that she struggles to make friends, as everyone sees her celebrity status before considering her personal self.

node.description:
Roman Torchwick is the cunning and charismatic leader of a band of thieves who operated in the city of Vale. He is a subordinate of [Cinder Fall](https://anilist.co/character/132316/Cinder-Fall), who had given him the mission to steal all of the Dust in the city, and later, a business partner of the White Fang. He often works alongside his associate, [Neopolitan](https://anilist.co/character/165118/Neopolitan).

A robbery lead by Roman was thwarted by [Ruby Rose](https://anilist.co/character/126569) at the beginning of the story and he developed a deep resentment towards her for this.

__Height:__ 198cm

The headmaster of Beacon Academy, he scouted Ruby and permitted her to enroll at Beacon based on her talents. He is typically both stoic and affable towards studnets, and fosters trust from those he speaks to. However, while he seems to have the best intentions, there are hints he's hiding things.

__Height:__ 183cm

A young Faunus from Vacuo with a monkey tail. He jokes a lot and doesn’t take too much seriously. Sun was a stowaway and a thief which was made easier by his light and agile abilities. On the other hand, he is compassionate and quickly bonds with Blake when cooperating with her.

One of the Main antagonists for two of the Main characters, Blake and Yang. His first appearance being in vol 2 when Cinder tries to get him to join her force. Later in Vol 3 makes a come back where he encounters two of the main characters. Becoming a huge part in Volumes 4 through 6.
